forks.question: What evidence lets the factory conclude that an executed two-way door needs no owner input and may be recorded as decided by agent?

options.says: The factory requires explicit authorization in the plan or review to record an executed two-way door as decided by agent, and otherwise records it as proposed.
The drafting agent may infer from the plan, merged change and review that an executed two-way door needs no owner input and record it as decided by agent, leaving all other decisions proposed.

forks.question: If drafting or creating the follow-up fails, its CI fails, or it has a merge conflict, how should the factory recover?

options.says: The factory automatically retries failed operations and repairs the same follow-up within the allowed file scope, merging only after CI passes.
The factory marks the work blocked after any such failure and waits for a person to request another attempt.
The factory retries failed drafting and creation automatically, but failed CI or a merge conflict blocks the work until a person requests another attempt.

forks.question: If a person closes the follow-up without merging it while the plan still owes the decision, what should the factory do?

options.says: The factory leaves the follow-up closed and waits for an explicit request to resume the same follow-up.
The factory automatically reopens the same follow-up because the decision remains owed.
